paite: Huan, leia mi tengteng pau khat leh thugen dan khat ahi ua.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, suahlama a kisuan jel laiun Sinar gamah phaijang a mu ua; huaiah a tengta uhi.
english: It happened, as they traveled east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

paite: Huan, Kisa un; teklei I bawl dia, hoih takin I hal ding, a kichita uhi. Huchiin, suang sikin teklei a nei ua, suanghukna sikin, longnai a nei uhi.
english: They said one to another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

paite: Huan, Kisa un, khopi i bawl dia, insang a vum van sun dingin I bawl dia, I min I thangsak ding uh; huchilouin jaw lei pumpiah hihdalhin I omkha ding, a chi uh.
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make ourselves a name, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

paite: Huan, Toupa mite taten khopi leh insang a lam khawng uh en dingin a hoh suka.
english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

paite: Huan, Toupan ngai dih ua, mipi te pumkhat ahi ua, a vek un lah pau khat a nei ngal ua; hiai thil a hih pan uhi; tun jaw a thilhih tup himhimte uh leng kham vual a hita kei ding.
english: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

paite: Kisa un, I va hoh suk ding, pau a kitheituah theihlouhna ding un, huailaiah a pau uh I vasuklamdangsak ding, a chi a.
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

paite: Huchiin, Toupan amaute huai akipanin lei tengteng ah a dalhsaka: huchiin a kho bawl uh a tawpsanta uhi.
english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

paite: Huaijiakin a min Babel a chi uh; Toupan amaute leitung tengteng ah a dalhsakta hi.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Hiai Sem suante ahi uh. Sem kum ja a upa ahi, tuichim tun nung kum nih nungin tapa Arpaksad a nei hi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem. Shem was one hundred years old and became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

paite: Huan, Arpaksad a neih nungin Sem kum za nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Arpaksadin, kum sawmthum leh kum nga a hihin, tapa Selah a neia:
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

paite: Huan, Selah a neih nungin Arpaksad kum zali leh kum thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Selahin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Eber a neia:
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber:

paite: Huan, Eber a neih nungin Selah kum zali leh kum thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: and Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Eberin, kum sawm thum leh kum li a hihin, tapa Peleg a neia:
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

paite: Huan, Peleg a neih nungin Eber kum zali leh kum sawm thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Pelegin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Reu a neia:
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

paite: Huan, Reu a neih nungin Peleg kum zanih leh kum kua a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Reuin, kum sawm thum leh kum nih a hihin, tapa Serug a neia:
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

paite: Huan, Serug a neih nungin Reu kum zanih leh kum sagih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Serugin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Nahor a neia:
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

paite: Huan Nahor a neih nungin Serug kum zanih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Nahorin, kum sawm nih leh kum kua ahihin, tapa Terah a neia:
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

paite: Huan, Terah aneih nungin Nahor kum za leh kum sawm leh kum kua a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Terahin, kum sawm sagih ahihin tapa Abram te, Nahor te, Haran te a nei hi.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

paite: Huan, hiaite Terah suante ahi uh. Terahin tapa Abram te, Nahor te, Haran te a neia; huan, Haranin tapa Lota a nei.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

paite: Huan, Haran a pianna gama, kaldaite khua Ur ah, apa Terah main a si hi.
english: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.

paite: Huan, Abram leh Nahorin ji a nei ua; Abram ji min Sarai ahia: Nahor ji min Haran tanu Milka ahi, Haran Milka pa leh Iska pa ahi.
english: Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.

paite: Huan, Sarai a chiinga; ta himhim a neikei.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

paite: Huan, Trahin tapa Abram te, a tapa tapa (Haran tapa) Lota te, a mou, a tapa Abram ji Sarai te a pia; huan, Kanana hoh dingin Kaldaite khua Ur akipanin a pawt khawmta uhi; huan, Haran khua a hongtun un, huailaiah a tengta uh.Huan, Terah damsung kum za nih leh kum nga ahi a: huan, Terah Haran khuaah a sita hi.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

paite: Huan, Terah damsung kum za nih leh kum nga ahi a: huan, Terah Haran khuaah a sita hi.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
